submitted.rationale: EQE peaks on the Cu-rich side of CuSb2O6. Measured values: Sb 0.35 → 0.0012%, 0.467 → 0.0104%, 0.505 → 0.0060%, 0.689 → 0.0018%, 0.80 → ~0%. XRD at index 6 matches rutile-type CuSb2O6 best (0.64) with extra Cu-rich features. So the photoactive region is CuSb2O6 with excess Cu near Sb ≈ 0.45–0.5. Index 5 gave the highest EQE measured.
